title: Reuse explicit alignment recipes
when: An example/proof frame contains aligned rows or paired columns.
do: Use matrix with lcol rows for homogeneous two-column lists.
Use eqalign with & and # for mathematical relation alignment.
Use native table/paragraph rows for mixed Korean prose, blanks, figures and formulas.
check: Source order, cell ownership, line wrapping and native glyph rendering.
limitation: Observed candidate recipes are not universal EqEdit syntax qualification; font/version changes invalidate native evidence.
